clue.text: Spoke to skilled prisoner first

indicators.note: first says the prisoner's letters lead, ahead of the word for skilled

parts.note: a con is crossword shorthand for a convict
versed means practised or knowledgeable

explanation.surface: Someone addressed an expert convict before anyone else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spoke to' reads as one phrase, but the definition is just 'Spoke'; 'to' joins it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to have conversed is to have talked with someone.

clue.text: Officer adopts Soviet ideology

indicators.note: adopts means the officer takes in the word for Soviet

parts.note: CO is a commanding officer
Red was the label for a Soviet communist

explanation.surface: A commander takes on communist beliefs.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a credo is a set of beliefs, a creed.

clue.text: Una, awkwardly placed, is queasy

indicators.note: awkwardly means the three letters of the name are jumbled

parts.note: seated means put in place, placed

explanation.surface: Una, seated uncomfortably, feels sick.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: feeling nauseous, ready to vomit.

clue.text: Understanding it makes one sick, when circuiting course

indicators.note: circuiting means the word for a vomit-inducer goes round the word for course

parts.note: an emetic is a substance that causes vomiting
a path is a course or route

explanation.surface: Seeing it causes nausea when doing laps of a racecourse, a sympathetic note.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: showing empathy means sharing and understanding another's feelings.

clue.text: Lay aside the Guardian among waste

indicators.note: among means the newspaper's pronoun sits inside the word for waste

parts.note: to spend money freely is to waste it
the clue is set in The Guardian, which may call itself us

explanation.surface: A newspaper is shelved among the rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter's paper speaks of itself as US.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to suspend is to put on hold, set aside for now.

clue.text: Vagrant clutches one set of papers

indicators.note: clutches means the vagrant holds the numeral within

parts.note: a dosser is British slang for a homeless person sleeping rough
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A tramp grips a bundle of documents.
explanation.walkthrough: A DOSSER is British slang for a vagrant who sleeps rough.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a dossier is a file of documents on one subject.

clue.text: Tiresome beat starts to test hotel resident's unruffled manner

indicators.note: starts to the following five words means take the opening letter of each one in turn

explanation.surface: A dull rhythm begins to wear down a hotel guest's calm demeanour.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrum is a steady monotonous drumming or strumming, a beat that grows wearisome.

clue.text: Drop speed

definitions.meaning: a teardrop, a single drop from the eye

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a teardrop, and racing along fast.

clue.text: Nationalist in revolt may cause a splash

indicators.note: in means the abbreviation goes inside the word for revolt

parts.note: a rising is a revolt, a rise

explanation.surface: A nationalist uprising could make headlines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make a splash' suggests news; the definition is literal water.
explanation.definitionFit: Rinsing something with water douses it, splashing it clean.

clue.text: I'm all done cooking piece of meat

indicators.note: cooking means the letters are worked up into a new dish

explanation.surface: A chef announces the steak is finished.
explanation.definitionFit: A medaillon (medallion) is a small round slice of meat, French in usage.

clue.text: Sally follows English outfit

indicators.note: follows puts the witty remark after the abbreviation for English

parts.note: a sally is a witty remark, a quip

explanation.surface: A girl called Sally comes after English in some kit list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sally' looks like a girl's name; here it is a witty retort.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to outfit someone is to provide them with gear, to kit them out.

clue.text: Took legal action about slur that's lasting

indicators.note: about means the word for went to court goes around the word for slur

parts.note: to have taken legal action against someone is to have sued
a slur on one's name is a stain

explanation.surface: A plaintiff went to court over a lasting insult.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something sustained is kept up over time, continuing and prolonged.

clue.text: Obvious successor holds a broadcast

parts.note: overt means open, plain to see

indicators.note: holds means the word for successor contains the letter given by 'a'

parts.note: an heir is one who succeeds to a title or estate

explanation.surface: The heir apparent has a turn, as in royal succession.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface hints at the heir apparent, but 'Obvious' is a separate piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: something sent by radio or television transmission goes out through the airwaves.

clue.text: Legendary creature one follows still

indicators.note: follows puts the numeral for one after the word for still

parts.note: still in the sense 'even now' means yet
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A mythical beast is tracked by a motionless follower.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the abominable snowman of the Himalayas is a creature of folklore.

clue.text: Cheating ruled out as arranged

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of the preceding words are reordered

explanation.surface: Cheating has been forbidden, as agreed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unfaithful to a spouse is called adultery.

clue.text: Priest endlessly seeking promotion is a fool

indicators.note: endlessly means the priest's title loses its final letter

parts.note: Father is the title of a Catholic priest
an ad promotes a product

explanation.surface: A cleric forever chasing advancement makes a fool of himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'promotion' looks like church advancement; it is an advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an informal British insult for a stupid person, a dimwit.

clue.text: Gift horse dealt with providence

indicators.note: dealt with means the letters of the phrase are handled into a new order

explanation.surface: Looking a gift horse in the mouth is prudence.
explanation.definitionFit: Providence in the sense of prudent foresight, planning for the future.

clue.text: Militant caught slashing tyre

indicators.note: slashing means the letter for caught cuts into the word for tyre

parts.note: a radial is a type of tyre with radially laid cords
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An activist was nabbed knifing someone's car tyre.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an extremist favouring thorough change is a militant.

clue.text: Tower that's ostentatious on a river

parts.note: camp means exaggerated and showy
the Nile is an African river

explanation.surface: A showy tower beside a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a campanile is a bell tower, often freestanding beside an Italian church.

clue.text: Composer has staff fiddle with opening of opera

parts.note: a rod is a stick or staff
to rig is to fiddle or fix fraudulently

indicators.note: opening of means take only the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A composer uses his baton to tinker with an opera's overture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddle' suggests a violin; it means to rig. Joaquín Rodrigo was the Spanish composer of the Concierto de Aranjuez.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Joaquín Rodrigo, the Spanish classical guitar composer.

clue.text: In Florida, king's to arrive wearing spectacles

indicators.note: wearing means the king and arrival go inside the spectacles

parts.note: OO looks like a pair of glasses
R stands for rex, king
to land is to arrive

explanation.surface: In Florida, a monarch is due to touch down in glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a city in central Florida, home to Disney World.

clue.text: Old king alone a short while with knight

parts.note: solo means alone, unaccompanied
a mo is a moment, a short while
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: An ancient monarch spent a brief solitary spell with a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the biblical King of Israel, son of David, famed for his wisdom.

clue.text: Knock over sketch and get let off

parts.note: a skit is a short comic sketch

indicators.note: off means the three letters of let are rearranged

explanation.surface: Knock down a comic sketch and escape punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: To skittle is to knock down, as pins in a skittle alley.

clue.text: Girl keeps king safe

indicators.note: keeps means the girl's name holds the letter for king inside it

parts.note: Sue is a girl's name
R is the abbreviation for rex, king

explanation.surface: A girl protects the king from harm, as on a chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: sure in the sense of secure or certain, as in a sure footing.

clue.text: Musical piece, where start of recapitulation's on the tonic

indicators.note: start of means take the first letter of the next word

parts.note: doh, spelt do, is the tonic note in sol-fa

explanation.surface: Musical analysis: a recapitulation begins on the home key.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a rondo is a musical form whose main theme keeps returning.

clue.text: Dunce's unfortunate to say it again

definitions.note: read as 'dunce is': unable to read and write

parts.note: ill as in ill luck means unfortunate
to iterate is to repeat, to say again

explanation.surface: A dunce bemoans that he must repeat himself.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', so the definition reads as a description of the dunce.
explanation.definitionFit: A dunce of the old schoolroom kind cannot read or write.

clue.text: Player's opening match

parts.note: E for East is one of the four players at bridge
a vent is an opening or outlet

explanation.surface: A player's first game.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge the four players are North, South, East and West, so E can be a player.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a sporting event is a match or contest.

clue.text: Excitement when trickster loses his head

indicators.note: loses his head means the swindler's word drops its first letter

parts.note: a cheat is a swindler or trickster

explanation.surface: Thrills arrive when a con man panics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses his head' suggests panic; it removes the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Heat as in the heat of the moment: passion, excitement.

clue.text: After a drink, German enthusiast gets a biscuit

indicators.note: After says the rest comes after the drink

parts.note: gin is a spirit
a nut is a fan, an enthusiast

explanation.surface: Following a tipple, a German fan is handed a cookie.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a hard ginger-flavoured British biscuit, popular for dunking in tea.

clue.text: Nothing's charged for fruit

parts.note: O is the figure zero, nothing
a live wire is electrically charged

explanation.surface: No fee is levied for a piece of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' reads as billed; it is electrically live.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the small oily stone fruit of a Mediterranean tree.

clue.text: Tory leader licking fish

indicators.note: leader means the opening letter of the word Tory

parts.note: a licking is a heavy defeat, a rout

explanation.surface: A Conservative chief is seen licking a fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'licking' looks literal; it means a thrashing.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a freshwater game fish of the salmon family.

clue.text: Exhausted when deliveries get impounded

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six deliveries by a bowler
pent means shut in, confined

explanation.surface: Worn out when one's parcels are seized.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled, so 'deliveries' gives OVERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Having spent beyond one's means, a budget is exhausted, used up entirely.
